## Research question

The completed fixed-path audit in PR122 found a hot-electron Compton loss near 2.58 eV per baryon. This draft continues with a bounded, native full63 gas-temperature coupling to determine the evolved temperature, charge and opacity response.

## Scope

- Two exclusive sources: the current integrated photon energy monopole (`actual_hot`) and a separately prescribed Planck-reference bath.
- Common inherited external UV moments; original atomic number rates and all 63 coupled coordinates retained.
- One analytic added Jacobian row, source-bound preflight, eight specified new IVPs, accepted nodes and 109/513/1025 retained grids.
- No replay of completed baselines. Opposite radiation sources are ledger entries only; physical HOLD, production NOT_APPROVED and REI_activation=false remain.

## Current checkpoint

Stage A theory/source snapshot is published. Local commit `10d515ac2def9b41890690d01b4bbd5915664a98`, remote commit `ca13937ab13bb13f211d83c7161319dfc28f4742`, exact whole tree `f93d3a90c9c96a17f366b541fcc245d9a90d48e9`.

Implementation preflight, new integrations, analysis and final delivery are still in progress; no new coupled result is claimed at this checkpoint. Final command/output and publication/backup receipts will be added after actual completion.

Stacked on draft PR122; no merge is requested.
